description:
Turns names into the handles Orbb takes, for a question about particular people rather than a company. The handles go to `orbbai_plan`.

IT RETURNS CANDIDATES AND NEVER PICKS: a common name comes back as several people with a headline and a company each, and the choice between them is yours.

Free.

ask.description: What this is for, in your user's own words. Optional; it is what later calls in this session weigh an answer against.

names.description: A full name, an email, or a LinkedIn URL. Add a company or title to the string where you have one — "Dana Mor, Head of Data at Acme" resolves far more often.

name: orbbai_people_resolve
title: Match Names to People
